title: A Garden Without a Single Measure of Success
title_ja: 一つの尺度では測れない庭
fact_notes: 人物・制度・具体的な出来事は架空の教材例・思考実験。実在の調査・統計・実証結果を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Imagine a school that has been given a neglected strip of land and asked to turn it into a garden serving several different purposes during the coming academic year.
sentences.ja: 放置された細長い土地を与えられ、次の学年度に複数の目的を果たす庭にするよう求められた学校を想像しよう。

sentences.en: The science department hopes to provide opportunities for observation, while the cooking club wants to harvest vegetables and the art club wishes to create an attractive place for sketching.
sentences.ja: 理科部門は観察の機会を提供したい一方、料理部は野菜を収穫し、美術部はスケッチに魅力的な場所を作りたい。

sentences.en: The groundskeeper reminds the students that the design must also take account of the staff time available for maintaining the site throughout the year.
sentences.ja: 用務員は設計に年間を通じて場所を管理するために使える職員の時間も考慮する必要があると注意する。

sentences.en: These objectives are not necessarily incompatible, but the group cannot assume that a single design will maximize every possible benefit at the same time.
sentences.ja: これらの目的は必ずしも両立不能ではないが、一つの設計ですべての利益を同時に最大化できるとは考えられない。

sentences.en: At the first meeting, the participants suggest judging the success of the garden by the total weight of vegetables harvested at the end of the season.
sentences.ja: 最初の会議では季節の終わりに収穫した野菜の総重量で庭の成功を判断する提案が出る。

sentences.en: Such a measurement would be relatively easy to record and compare, and it would give the cooking club a clear indication of whether its initial expectations had been met.
sentences.ja: その測定は比較的記録・比較しやすく、料理部の当初の期待が満たされたか明確に示す。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, a section of the garden devoted to observing insects or drawing plants might make an important contribution without producing anything that could be weighed on a scale.
sentences.ja: それでも昆虫の観察や植物の描画に充てる場所は、はかりで量れるものを生産せず重要な貢献をするかもしれない。

sentences.en: If the participants were rewarded exclusively for increasing the harvest, they might gradually remove features that had originally been included to serve other educational purposes.
sentences.ja: 収穫量の増加だけで評価されれば、当初他の教育目的のために含めた特徴を徐々に取り除くかもしれない。

sentences.en: The group therefore develops a plan that divides the site into several sections with different functions instead of attempting to cultivate every available square meter in exactly the same way.
sentences.ja: そこで利用可能な土地のすべてを同じ方法で耕すのでなく、場所を異なる機能を持つ区画に分ける計画を作る。

sentences.en: Students decide to keep separate records of harvest, observations, use by different classes, and the time required for maintenance, without combining these into an artificial overall score.
sentences.ja: 収穫、観察、各クラスの利用、管理に要する時間を別々に記録し、人工的な総合点にはまとめないことにする。

sentences.en: Whenever two objectives compete for space or resources, the records will help the group discuss the specific trade-off instead of simply announcing that one proposal is better than another.
sentences.ja: 二つの目的が場所や資源を争うたび、単に一方が優れていると宣言せず具体的な両立困難な選択を議論する助けになる。

sentences.en: The students also agree to describe the limitations of their records, since a brief classroom observation cannot establish the long-term ecological value of a particular planting arrangement.
sentences.ja: 短時間の教室活動の観察では特定の植栽の長期的な生態学的価値を確定できないため、記録の限界も説明することにする。

sentences.en: During the first term, the cooking club finds that its section requires more attention than expected, whereas another section attracts frequent visits from students working on visual projects.
sentences.ja: 最初の学期に料理部の区画は予想より手入れが必要で、別の区画には視覚的な活動をする生徒が頻繁に訪れる。

sentences.en: The groundskeeper proposes reducing the size of the vegetable section in order to keep the total maintenance workload within the time the school can realistically provide.
sentences.ja: 用務員は管理作業の総負担を学校が現実的に提供できる時間内に収めるため、野菜区画を縮小する提案をする。

sentences.en: Although the change would reduce the potential harvest, the cooking club accepts it after discussing the relationship between its ambitions and the practical limits of the shared garden.
sentences.ja: 変更は収穫見込みを減らすが、料理部は目標と共有庭園の実際的制約の関係を議論した上で受け入れる。

sentences.en: The reports do not prove that the revised design is the best possible garden, but they give the participants a more explicit account of why they made their decisions.
sentences.ja: 報告は修正設計が最善だと証明しないが、決定の理由をより明確に説明できる。

sentences.en: The example illustrates that environmental planning often involves choices about which outcomes deserve attention, not merely technical questions about how to achieve a predetermined target.
sentences.ja: この例は環境計画が既定の目標をどう達成するかという技術的問題だけでなく、どの成果に注意を払うべきかという選択を含むことを示す。

sentences.en: A measurement can be valuable without representing every aspect of the activity, provided its users recognize what the measurement includes and what it leaves out.
sentences.ja: 何を含み何を除くか利用者が認識するなら、測定は活動の全側面を代表せずとも価値がある。

sentences.en: The value of the garden depends partly on decisions about its purposes that cannot be settled by adding together quantities that describe fundamentally different kinds of achievement.
sentences.ja: 庭の価値は根本的に異なる成果の量を足し合わせるだけでは決められない目的についての判断にも左右される。

sentences.en: A responsible evaluation is therefore one that makes competing values visible and allows a community to reconsider them when its circumstances change.
sentences.ja: 責任ある評価とは競合する価値を見えるようにし、状況が変わったとき地域が再考できるようにするものだ。

vocabulary.definition: in a way suited to actual conditions

questions.prompt: Which constraint did the groundskeeper emphasize?
options: The total price of harvested produce.
A fixed requirement to remove all plants.

questions.prompt: Why might a single design be insufficient?
options: Different purposes may demand competing uses of the same site.
The land has no possible use.
questions.explanation_ja: 目的によって資源が競合する。

questions.prompt: Why was harvest weight initially attractive as a measure?
options: It was comparatively easy to record and compare.

questions.prompt: What could exclusive rewards for harvest cause?
options: Removal of features serving other goals.
More accurate measurement of artistic value.
questions.explanation_ja: 他の目的の特徴が失われる恐れ。

questions.prompt: How did students organize their records?
options: Converted everything into a single score.

questions.prompt: What is the function of the separate records?
options: Prove the garden is ecologically optimal.
questions.explanation_ja: 具体的な両立困難性を議論する。

questions.prompt: Why did the cooking club accept a smaller harvest?
options: It had no interest in vegetables.
It proved harvest measurements were false.
It had been excluded from all discussions.
It considered the limits of shared maintenance resources.
questions.explanation_ja: 管理資源の限界を考慮。

options: The greatest harvest always defines a successful garden.
Every outcome should be converted into identical units.
Environmental projects should avoid all measurements.
Evaluation should recognize multiple purposes and the limits of individual measures.
questions.explanation_ja: 複数目的と測定の限界を認識する。

grammar.focus: while the cooking club wants to harvest vegetables
If the participants were rewarded exclusively
grammar.explanation_ja: 仮定法過去とmightで仮想の結果を表す。

paraphrases.source: The science department hopes to provide opportunities for observation, while the cooking club wants to harvest vegetables and the art club wishes to create an attractive place for sketching.
paraphrases.rewrite: Science wants observation, whereas the cooking club seeks vegetables and the art club seeks a place to draw.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 三つの目的を対比する。

paraphrases.source: If the participants were rewarded exclusively for increasing the harvest, they might gradually remove features that had originally been included to serve other educational purposes.
paraphrases.rewrite: Rewarding only larger harvests could encourage the removal of elements intended for other educational aims.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 単一の評価目標が他目的を損ね得る。

paraphrases.source: Whenever two objectives compete for space or resources, the records will help the group discuss the specific trade-off instead of simply announcing that one proposal is better than another.
paraphrases.rewrite: When resources cannot satisfy both goals at once, the records can make the actual compromise clearer.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 競合時に具体的な選択を明確にする。

paraphrases.source: A measurement can be valuable without representing every aspect of the activity, provided its users recognize what the measurement includes and what it leaves out.
paraphrases.rewrite: A measure need not cover everything to be useful if its scope and omissions are understood.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 範囲と除外を理解すれば測定は有用。

discourse.role_ja: 目的の両立可能性と資源制約。
収穫指標の価値と限界。

cloze.explanation_ja: 収穫だけで評価する場合。
目的間の両立困難な選択。
